reports.title: Annual national accounts
reports.description: Italian national accounts estimates compiled under ESA 2010, published as ESMS metadata and annual press releases.

reports.title: Statistical register of active enterprises (ASIA-Enterprises)
reports.description: Census-type statistical register of active enterprises, named as a core supply-side source for Italian national accounts.

reports.title: Frame-SBS (information system on economic results of enterprises)
reports.description: Micro-database of annual financial statements for active market enterprises within the ASIA-Enterprises register, built from administrative archives plus PMI and SCI surveys; primary source for enterprise economic results in national accounts.

reports.title: Balance of Payments
reports.description: Italian balance of payments, compiled by the Bank of Italy and named as the source for trade-in-services data feeding national accounts.

reports.title: National accounts (ESA 2010)
reports.description: Czech national accounts, with a published ESA 2010 GNI Inventory at a level of detail comparable to Germany, France and the Netherlands.

reports.title: Balance of Payments
reports.description: Czech balance of payments, compiled by the central bank and named as a source for national accounts.

dependencies.basis: "National accounts estimates are produced in accordance with the provisions of the European System of National and Regional Accounts Manual (ESA 2010), which represents the application at European level of the System of National Accounts (SNA 2008) of the United Nations. The methodological provisions act as binding rules for EU member states, ensuring comparability of the estimates. ESA 2010 was introduced by Regulation (EU) of the European Parliament and of the Council No 549/2013."

"As regards estimates of the supply side, the most relevant sources are those providing census-type information on enterprises: the statistical register of active enterprises (ASIA-Enterprises) and the information system on economic results of enterprises (Frame-SBS in the following)."

"This micro database includes information on economic results for the whole population of active market enterprises (excluding agriculture and financial intermediation). It is built through a complex integration procedure of data from administrative archives, treated statistically and combined with data drawn from the survey on small and medium enterprises (PMI) and from the survey on the financial statements of large enterprises (SCI)."

"As regards foreign trade (imports and exports of goods and services), the data derive from the survey on traded goods (Intrastat and Extrastat components) conducted by Istat and from information on the trade of services extracted from the Balance of Payments compiled by the Bank of Italy."

"Within the NA compilations the CZSO strictly follows the ESA 2010 methodology." Reinforced by the existence of a published ESA 2010 GNI Inventory (2018 and 2022 editions listed on the ČSÚ methodology page).

"It relies on a variety of data sources, including administrative data: car and business registers, accounting statements, tax data, budgetary reports, population censuses, statistical surveys of businesses and households, statements of supervising institutions and branch organisations, annual and quarterly reports, trade statistics on goods and services, balance of payments information." ČNB is the publicly documented compiler of Czech BoP.
